world_news_real.title: Explosion on Russian ship at Libya port caused by suspected drone attack, officials say
world_news_real.description: Libya's eastern government says the ship had stopped for fuel and supplies on its way back to Russia.

world_news_real.title: South Korea education minister resigns over exam cheating scandal
world_news_real.description: Choi Kyo-jin admits last-minute measures to stop AI-assisted cheating during the college entrance exam caused chaos.

world_news_real.title: Russia-bound ship towed away after it was attacked in Gulf of Finland
world_news_real.description: Finnish defence forces say that Ukraine was likely behind the drone strike on Saturday. Kyiv has yet to comment.

world_news_real.title: Mexican drug lord on FBI's 10 most wanted list arrested in shoot-out
world_news_real.description: Fausto Isidro "Chapo Idisro" Meza Flores, who is accused of drug trafficking and torture, is detained after gun fight with authorities.

world_news_real.title: Three killed and dozens missing after fire at Indonesian factory
world_news_real.description: At least three people were killed and many more feared dead after a fire at a confectionary factory.

world_news_real.title: Italian jeweller and businessman Paolo Bulgari dies aged 89
world_news_real.description: In a statement to Italian media, his family remember him as "the greatest jeweller of our time".

world_news_real.title: FBI reportedly investigating apparent hack of its criminal database
world_news_real.description: The National Crime Information Center database is used by federal and local law enforcement to share information.

world_news_real.title: Zelensky says Crimean Bridge strikes 'fair response' as he meets UK's Streeting
world_news_real.description: Ukraine's president says Kyiv acted after 109 separate Russian aerial attacks on bridges in Ukraine.

world_news_real.title: Lock of former US President George Washington's hair sells for $4,000
world_news_real.description: The hair was given as a sign of friendship shortly before Washington's death in 1799, according to a descendent of its former owner.

world_news_real.title: Man convicted of starting Palisades fire in Los Angeles
world_news_real.description: The 30-year-old LA resident was convicted of arson leading to wildfires that killed 12 people and destroyed more than 6,800 buildings.
